steps.text:
View Policy History: 
 -  Navigate to the ' Travel Insurance ' section. 
 -  Scroll to the Policy History section to view active and inactive policies.

Download Policies: 
 - Tap on Download Policy for any listed policy to save a copy of the insurance details.
Ensure all details (e.g., travel dates, destination, and passport information) are accurate before proceeding.
Refer to the terms and conditions for detailed coverage and exclusions.
